Everything the reports screen needs already exists. There is no UI layer (no components or screens) in the project, so the features are plain TS modules.

| Work needed | Existing code |
|---|---|
| Call `GET /api/reports` | `request<T>(path)` at `the request wrapper:3`. It prefixes `/api` (`the request wrapper:1`), adds the bearer token, retries 5xx responses, and parses the JSON. Call it as `request<Report[]>('/reports')`. |
| Fetch a list from the API in a feature module | `listOrders()` at `src/features/orders/index.ts:6-8` is a one-line `request<Order[]>('/orders')`. `listReports()` should follow the same shape. |
| Declare the `{ …, totalCents }` row type | `Order` at `src/features/orders/index.ts:4`. `src/features/cart/index.ts:4` (`CartItem`) uses the same `...Cents: number` naming. |
| Show cents as a price | `formatPrice(cents)` at `src/lib/money.ts:3-5`. It formats USD with `Intl.NumberFormat` and divides by 100. |
| Build a display line from a row and a price | `orderLabel()` at `src/features/orders/index.ts:14-16` (`#id: $x`) and the cart line formatting at `src/features/cart/index.ts:34-35`. A `reportLabel` such as `` `${r.month}: ${formatPrice(r.totalCents)}` `` should copy this. |
| Feature folder layout | `src/features/orders/index.ts` and `src/features/cart/index.ts`. Each feature is a single `index.ts`, so `src/features/reports/index.ts` fits. |

Nothing in the project covers rendering a screen, so that part is new. The data and formatting code can all be reused.

I changed no files.
